tldr: Mercury in Aries: the mind is direct, fast, and built for decisive speech.
body: With Mercury in Aries, thoughts move quickly and words arrive with heat. You communicate best when honesty is allowed to be clean and immediate, without turning every exchange into a contest.
gift: Fast decisions, bold speech, problem-solving under pressure, and mental courage.
challenge: Interrupting, impatience, verbal combat, or deciding before listening.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
